modules.module_title: Taking charge of shift from jute beaming operator

pcs.pc_description: reach at least 15 - 20 minutes early to the work place
ensure in consultation with supervisor, proper man-machine allocation to the extent possible
make arrangement for necessary operational tools (knife, piecing hooks and winding knotter hook etc. required for this department)

collect from spinning sardar of previous shift information regarding process parameters, material flow, material shortage, if any, quality change and quality codes and machine breakdown and maintenance undertaken

assess the fed material (jute sliver from 3rd/finisher drawing) position and report to supervisor for excess or shortage of any particular quality material/sliver/empty cans/empty bobbins etc.in the spinning department .i.e. from 3rd/finisher jute drawing to winding
check quality of feed material (sliver from finisher drawing machine) for spinning and winding machine (right quality of warp and weft yarn and defects in spinning bobbins)
take a quick round in the department to check that in spinning department there is no undesirable mixing of material such as fibre, cans/bobbins etc. deviating from production plan/schedule
find out the nature of breakdown, cause and the machine idle time, if a breakdown occur in this shift or even in previous shift
assure the availability of full sliver cans to feed in the spinning machine required, and numbers of spinning and that of bobbins to be feed in winding machine (warp and weft winding)
ensure that there is no roller lapping in jute spinning frame (coarser and fine jute yarn count) and winding machines (warp/spool winding and weft/cop winding
check and to collect the report regarding the cleanliness of the machines & working areas
tune/check mechanical fault of the spinning and winding machine for deciding about necessary action for its maintenance in time before breakdown
rectify, in consultation with supervisor any anomalies in yarn count, if found from SQC report
assure during shift change all the spinning and winding machines are in running condition for specific yarn quality
ensure that machines are cleaned and lubricated properly during shift change
get clearance from the incoming counterpart Sardar (Jobber) before leaving the work spot after change of shift

pcs.pc_description: hand over the shift to the incoming spinning sardar in proper manner and get clearance from the incoming counterpart

report to the supervisor all specific observations for all running jute spinning and winding machinery (about their running/shortages of feed materials, if any/maintenance required/done in any of machinery and absenteeism of workman)

modules.module_title: Ensuring process and quality control in jute spinning and winding

pcs.pc_description: check the delivered material from finisher drawing frames in jute mills
ensure that all indicator and stop motions are in working condition and are operating properly
ensure sufficient number of finisher drawing sliver can stock
check that proper number of doubling (2:1) is maintained by the operator at the finisher drawing frame, so that right quality in finisher drawing sliver is maintained as per jute yarn grist
independently to take operators report on the machines, immediately after breakdown occurs or any anomalies found / reported by the operator or by the Sardar himself
ensure the removal of sliver lapping is done by the operator, without using knife and without damaging machine parts in spinning machine
ensure that quality-wise identification mark for jute yarn (sacking warp, sacking weft, hessian warp, hessian weft and any other qualities) is proper

follow the instruction of shift supervisor for changing any quality of jute yarn and related change in machine setting / parts and process parameter in jute spinning machine
record shift-wise wastage and report to supervisor if it is beyond the norm (0.5 % - 1 % in spinning and 0.2% - 0.3% in winding)
ensure that empty sliver cans remain clean and fully empty before they are returned to the back process (finisher drawing machine)
check time to time proper functioning of jute sliver crimping device in finisher drawing machine
ensure that all jute sliver wastes are kept inside designated waste sliver cans only for returning to the back process for further use

ensure proper picking and cleaning of finisher drawing machine to avoid sliver shortage/wastage and to ensure that proper quality of fed jute sliver etc. are maintained as per spinning and winding production schedule
ensure that the machines are well maintained, tuned/set and cleaned and lubricated properly following routine/schedule maintenance and smoot production

modules.module_title: Maintaining quality in Jute spinning and winding

pcs.pc_description: check whether the jute sliver quality and jute yarn quality according to desired quality standards and specifications for the specific industry
ensure that proper identification mark is always present for different counts of jute yarns being spun or wound
ensure that uniform bobbin weight is maintained in spinning machine
check and arrange replacement of defective machine parts of spinning and winding machinery by maintenance people in jute mills
ensure proper wound angle and diameter in spool (warp package) and proper diameter, cone length and length of the cop for jute weft (cop) yarn

ensure that operator follows the right piecing (minimum overlapping of sliver) in spinning and minimum overlapping in jute yarn in winding machine by appropriate method and use of coloured yarn while piecing export quality yarn
check and ask the maintenance department to rectify if there is any defect in the building of the bobbins (in spinning) or building the warp package (spool) and weft package (cop)
ensure minimum sliver/yarn wastage during piecing and can changing
ensure that operator must keep waste material inside his waste collection bag
ensure the use of graphite powder lubricant (no grease/oil) in builder rail
find out the causes of end break in spinning machine, end break in winding (warp and weft) machine and take the remedial measures for excessive end breakage
follow the instruction of Supervisor/shift In- charge during change of count and quality
check frequently the quality of cop and spool and ensure that quality standards and specifications are maintained
keep the empty spinning bobbin in the container provided for this
ensure that operators join the broken ends by proper weavers knots using mechanical knotter hook
ensure that operators make the knots small and tight, with minimum yarn wastage
ensure that operators release the yarn tightly after knotting to avoid snarls formation
ensure that winding tension in all drum/spindles are same and uniform throughout winding operation
ensure that defective packages (bobbins) are kept separately
check the mark on the bobbin so that lot mixing can be avoided
minimize unnecessary wastage of yarn while removing faults or during starting of winding and knotting
report immediately to the supervisor or concern superiors, if any technological or mechanical problem occurs in machine
ensure that no drum (for spool) or spindle(for cop) should remain idle in winding machinery
ensure that all spinning bobbins are fully consumed/emptied if for any reason, it cannot be done, manual unwinding/emptying the spinning bobbins is to be arranged separately

pcs.pc_description: maintain personal hygiene and human safety, machine safety and specific dress code
carefully handle raw jute, slivers of jute, jute yarns and fabrics to minimize wastage
carefully handle all tools such as hand root cutter, circular blade motorized root cutter, chopper, wooden block, bale hook, rope cutter, picking hook, brooms etc
carefully handle moisture meter
carefully handle weigh machine

use proper mechanical handling equipment for lifting and handling jute and other materials, Mechanical Handling Equipment: hand barrow, can trolley, bobbin trolley, beam carrier, spool carrier, cloth carrier etc.
keep all waste jute materials in a specified place for further processing
maintain a clean and hazard free working area, keeping floors free from all encumbrances
maintain tools and equipment being used for jute processing
carry out scheduled running maintenance like shift-wise cleaning and oiling in respective jute processing machinery
report to supervisor for any abnormal sound, from any machine for jute processing
report to supervisor all anomalies and unsafe conditions of equipment and other unprecedented occurrences
ensure that the doors and covers for gear side/ belt side of the jute machinery are kept properly closed and all machine guards are in appropriate place
ensure that standing place in working position are free from all encumbrances, to maintain correct posture of working/sitting/standing during working in respective jute processing machinery
use appropriate cleaning equipment like knife, brooms, pliers, screw driver etc. and follow appropriate cleaning methods for the work to be carried out in particular jute processing machine
stack/dispose jute fibre/sliver/yarn waste safely in the designated location/place/bag to help usage of all wastages for further processing
store all gadgets, tools and cleaning equipment safely after their use in designated place after cleaning them properly
carry out cleaning and minor/small maintenance jobs for each jute processing machine as per schedule within limits of specific responsibility, as instructed

modules.module_title: Comply with industry and organizational requirement in jute sector

pcs.pc_description: perform assigned duties effectively section- wise / machine- wise
take full responsibility for desired performance
be accountable towards the job role and assigned duties
report any anomalies found in the section / machinery to the Sardar (Jobber) or Supervisors
take drive on self-learning for improving efficiency
co-ordinate with all the team members and colleagues
communicate politely
avoid conflicts and miscommunication
take part in Quality Circle activity to discuss process and innovative ideas in Quality Circle
take all initiative to achieve organisational norms for processing of yarn and fabrics of jute and to motivate all other fellow workers to follow them
implement the collection of wastage in a proper method (as instructed) for further processing
follow specific environmental regulation for jute industry
keep area of work and machine clean
